name: Interphone
summary: Perth fibre/satellite ISP (Interphone Pty Ltd, ABN 163 794 483, AS134980), trading as Fibrenet; distributed GPON fibre network for developers, lifestyle/retirement villages, businesses and homes; one of the few Perth fibre providers.

events.details: AS134980 allocated 16 Dec 2015; Perth GPON fibre ISP trading as Fibrenet. CAUTION: fibrenet.com.au captures before Dec 2015 are a parked page ('FibreNet.com.au Offer'), not the ISP; Wayback via this domain does not support the bound.

refs.label: Perth company Interphone Pty Ltd (ACN 163 794 483) registered/ABN activated May 2013.
First Wayback capture of the trading domain predates the ABN by a few weeks.
Its site footer dates the current Perth business to 2013.
